h1: Human approval steps for your AI workflows
overview: Some outputs should never leave your business without a person looking at them. We add approval points to a workflow you already run, such as a draft reply, a price change or a document summary. The reviewer gets a short message with the draft, the source and two buttons, approve or send back. Rules decide which items need a check and which can pass, so your team only reviews what matters.

faq: Do I need a workflow already running?
Yes, there should be a process that produces something to review. If it does not exist yet, order workflow design first and we add approval points as part of the map.
Wherever your team already works, such as email, Slack, Microsoft Teams or a shared sheet. We choose the channel with you so nobody needs a new tool to learn.
Yes. We write simple rules, for example orders under a set value or replies from a trusted template can pass, while anything unusual waits for a person. You can change the rules later.
Can an AI tool approve its own work?
We do not set it up that way. The approval step is for a named person or team. The tool can prepare a draft and a short reason, but a human makes the final call.
